lines.text: Many learners say: He is very sympathetic.
Nice! My friend is very nice.

native.caption: Du willst sagen, dass jemand sympathisch ist? 😬 “Sympathetic” heißt mitfühlend. Falsch: “He is very sympathetic.” Richtig: “He is very nice.” Hör Ama zu und sprich nach! Mehr üben in der Lexkite-App.
native.comment: Lösung: “nice”. Richtig heißt es: “He is very nice.” Übe mehr mit einem kostenlosen Quiz: {link}

en.hook: Do you want to say someone is likeable?
en.caption: “Sympathetic” means mitfühlend in German, not sympathisch. Wrong: “He is very sympathetic.” Right: “He is very nice.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
